english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing an action that looks easy and requires little effort.
Use this when “carefree” emphasizes feeling relaxed, unpressured, or free from difficulty rather than having no worries at all.
Use 輕鬆 when a task or duty is easy and not demanding.

examples.english: They made doing the homework look effortless.
examples.traditional: 佢做份功課做得好輕鬆。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 hou2 hing1 sung1

examples.english: Today's work is light, so doing it feels carefree.
examples.traditional: 今日啲工作唔多，做起上嚟好輕鬆。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 gung1 zok3 m4 do1 zou6 hei2 soeng6 lai4 hou2 hing1 sung1

examples.english: This homework is light and easy to do; I'll finish it in a little while.
examples.traditional: 呢份功課做起上嚟好輕鬆，我一陣就做完。
